Thank you for opening your first issue on Verticopolis, @{login}! 🎉

Reports like this are how the game gets better. A maintainer will take a look soon and may ask a question or two.

If you'd like to help with this or anything else, [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/{repo}/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains how to get set up, and issues labeled [good first issue](https://github.com/{repo}/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22) or [help wanted](https://github.com/{repo}/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22help+wanted%22) are a good place to start.
